verdict.rationale: Statsig supports gradual/scheduled rollouts, feature-gate emergency kill switches, and metric-based experimentation with alerting for regressions (Infra Analytics 'set alerts to catch regressions'), giving the pieces needed to guard a rollout with metrics. However, none of the evidence shows an automated rollback action triggered by a detected metric regression — alerts and kill switches appear to require manual intervention rather than an automatic release rollback loop. Missing for 10: documented automatic rollback/kill-switch triggered by metric threshold breach, closed-loop guardrail-to-rollback automation, and independent confirmation this works in production.
